build_freeze_gc_heap: build a function to freeze all GC-tracked objects after server warmup to reduce GC overhead
create_GCDebugConfig: create a GC debug configuration from a string enabling elapsed times or top collected object reporting
test_GCDebugger: test the GCDebugger class that logs GC cycle elapsed times and top collected object types
run_maybe_attach_gc_debug_callback: run the function that attaches a GC debug callback when VLLM_GC_DEBUG environment variable is enabled
review_freeze_gc_heap: review the freeze_gc_heap function that pushes static objects to oldest GC generation and freezes them
